Test_Objective: Verify unauthenticated user can access login page via direct URL
Precondition: User is not logged in; browser is open
Steps:
1. Open browser
2. Navigate to the login page URL
Expected_Result: Login page displayed with hero visual; 'LOGIN With Google' button; header and footer visible

Test_Objective: Verify authenticated user is redirected away from login page
Precondition: User is already logged in with a valid session
Steps:
1. Log in with a valid Google account
2. Navigate to the login page URL directly
Expected_Result: User redirected to homepage or dashboard; login page not displayed

Test_Objective: Verify unauthenticated user accessing a protected page is redirected to login
Precondition: User is not logged in; browser is open
Steps:
1. Open browser
2. Navigate to a protected page URL

Test_Objective: Verify overall screen layout and key visual elements
Precondition: User navigated to login page; user is not logged in
Steps:
1. Open login page
2. Observe overall structure from top to bottom
3. Verify all primary sections visible
Expected_Result:
Header displayed at top with Logo (top-left) and Language selector 'VN' (top-right)
Hero section displayed in center with 'ROOT FURTHER' title; description text; and 'LOGIN With Google' button with Google icon
Key visual artwork displayed as background
Footer displayed at bottom with copyright text 'Bản quyền thuộc về Sun* © 2025'

Test_Objective: Verify language selector shows default language
Steps:
1. Open login page
2. Observe language selector in header
Expected_Result: Language selector displays 'VN' with country flag icon and downward chevron

Test_Objective: Verify clicking Login button initiates Google OAuth flow
Precondition: User is on login page; user is not logged in
Steps:
1. Open login page
2. Click 'LOGIN With Google' button
3. Complete Google OAuth authentication
Expected_Result:
Google OAuth authentication flow opens
User authenticated successfully
User redirected to homepage

Test_Objective: Verify login button transitions to disabled/loading state after click
Precondition: User is on login page; button is in enabled state
Steps:
1. Open login page
2. Observe button is enabled
3. Click 'LOGIN With Google' button
4. Observe button state during processing
Expected_Result:
Button becomes disabled immediately after click
Loading spinner displayed on button
Button does not respond to additional clicks (double-click prevention)

Test_Objective: Verify clicking language selector opens dropdown
Steps:
1. Open login page
2. Click on the language selector ('VN')
Expected_Result: Language dropdown menu opens with available language options

Test_Objective: Verify hovering language selector shows highlight effect
Steps:
1. Open login page
2. Hover mouse over the language selector ('VN')
Expected_Result:
Highlight effect displayed on language selector
Cursor changes to pointer

Test_Objective: Verify Google OAuth login flow for first-time user not logged into Google
Precondition: User is on login page; no Google account logged in on browser
Steps:
1. Open login page (no Google account logged in on browser)
2. Click 'LOGIN With Google' button
3. Google login screen appears
4. Enter Google credentials and authenticate
Expected_Result:
Google login screen displayed
After authentication; user logged in successfully and redirected to homepage

Test_Objective: Verify user is redirected to homepage after successful Google login
Precondition: User is on login page; user has a valid Google account
Steps:
1. Open login page
2. Click 'LOGIN With Google' button
3. Complete Google OAuth authentication successfully
Expected_Result:
User redirected to homepage/dashboard after successful login
Login page no longer displayed
